subject.title: refactor(agents): compress model prompts and tool instructions

question: May this PR intentionally change the values of the deprecated but exported GPT-5 Plugin SDK prompt constants?
rationale: The constants remain externally importable and the generated API baseline records four changed values; only maintainer intent can define whether this consumer-observable compatibility change is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve exported values
options.body: Keep the public constants byte-stable and route bundled runtime behavior through compact internal constants.

options.title: Accept the value change
options.body: Explicitly approve the changed exported values and own the downstream compatibility impact after focused consumer proof.

options.title: Split the SDK change
options.body: Land internal prompt compaction separately and handle exported prompt retirement or migration in a dedicated change.

recommendation.title: Preserve exported values
recommendation.body: Keep the public constants byte-stable and route bundled runtime behavior through compact internal constants.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across both the prompt runtime and Plugin SDK boundary and is assigned to the PR.
